justification: Inspected `core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/demo/MakeHotSpotLog.java`: the package contains only this one class, and its imports are limited to JDK types plus `com.chrisnewland.freelogj`; it does not import or call any other repository packages. `rg` over production sources found no `core/src/main/java` or `ui/src/main/java` references to `MakeHotSpotLog` beyond the class itself, so the package has no internal outgoing dependencies that could make it depend on a less stable package. References exist only from tests and demo scripts (`scripts/makeDemoLogFile.sh`, `scripts/makeDemoLogFile.bat`, and several test files), which does not indicate unstable internal dependencies.
